source: Evergreen picks from official museum, park and city pages, plus the Nassau Inn's tavern by Palmer Square (Nov 2026); restaurant picks still thin

spots.name: Yankee Doodle Tap Room
spots.cuisine: Historic tavern at the Nassau Inn

spots.name: New Jersey State Museum
spots.blurb: Natural history, archaeology, fine art and New Jersey history, with free general admission. Planetarium shows cost extra; closed Mondays.
spots.blurbEs: Historia natural, arqueología, arte e historia de Nueva Jersey, con entrada general gratis. El planetario se paga aparte; cierra los lunes.

spots.name: Old Barracks Museum
spots.blurb: The 1758 barracks where Hessian soldiers were quartered during the Battle of Trenton, now a living-history museum.
spots.blurbEs: El cuartel de 1758 donde se alojaban los soldados hessianos durante la Batalla de Trenton, hoy un museo de historia viva.

spots.name: Cadwalader Park
spots.blurb: Trenton's Olmsted-designed park, home to the Trenton City Museum at Ellarslie.
spots.blurbEs: El parque de Trenton diseñado por Olmsted, sede del Trenton City Museum en Ellarslie.

spots.name: Grounds For Sculpture
spots.blurb: A large outdoor sculpture park and museum in Hamilton; open daily except Tuesdays. Adults $25, ages 6–17 $12.
spots.blurbEs: Un gran parque de esculturas al aire libre y museo en Hamilton; abre todos los días excepto los martes. Adultos $25, de 6 a 17 años $12.

spots.name: Palmer Square
spots.blurb: Princeton's town square of shops and restaurants across from the university, with holiday entertainment on December weekends.
spots.blurbEs: La plaza de tiendas y restaurantes de Princeton frente a la universidad, con entretenimiento navideño los fines de semana de diciembre.
